newsitem.title: USA: Precision Castparts Acquires O.I.C. Valves.
newsitem.headline: Precision Castparts Acquires O.I.C. Valves.

text.p: Precision Castparts Corp said it has acquired O.I.C. Valves of Houston, as part of its plan to strengthen unit PCC Flow Technologies and reduce fragmentation in the pump and valve industry.

In a statement issued late on Thursday, Precision Castparts said O.I.C. Valves offers stainless steel gate, globe, and check valves for chemical, petrochemical, pulp and paper, and power industry applications.
Precision Castparts Corp is a worldwide manufacturer of complex metal components and products.
